title: Add Fuel Hydrant at Pumphouse 3 and 4, US NAVSUPPACT Andersen AFB, Guam
description: This is a Sources Sought announcement only. This is not a solicitation announcement for proposals and no contract will be awarded from this announcement. No reimbursement will be made for any costs associated with providing information in response to this announcement. No telephone calls will be accepted requesting a bid package or solicitation because there is no bid package or solicitation available. In order to protect the procurement integrity of any future procurement, if any, that may arise from this announcement, information regarding the technical point of contact will not be given and no appointments for presentations will be made. The intent of this synopsis is to identify potential sources that are capable of performing construction that adds eleven new fuel hydrant outlets and associated 14" stainless steel hydrant loop piping to the south side of the Center Ramp in accordance with the latest military standards (UFC 3-460-01 Petroleum Fuel Facilities, DoD Standard Design AW 078-24-28 Pressurized Hydrant Fueling System, Type III). The new lines will tie into the existing hydrant piping north of Taxilane C. The existing return piping will be abandoned in place. The project work scope will include fuel piping, grounding, new Emergency Fuel Shutoff stations, cathodic protection systems, demolition of concrete pavement, repair of pavement, and all other necessary support. Site preparation consists of simple excavation and pavement demolition / replacement for new underground utilities and fueling pits. Environmental mitigation includes archaeological monitoring and contaminated soil management. Construction will occur on an active airfield. The magnitude of construction for this project is anticipated to be between $100,000,000 and $250,000,000. The Government will evaluate responses based upon small business program representation, experience, and bonding capacity. Interested sources having the capability to perform this work are invited to submit the attached Questionnaire (Attachment 1) and the Experience Questionnaire (Attachment 2). Your submission is limited to a total of ten (10) single-sided pages, 8.5� x 11� (210 x 297 mm), and 10-point font or larger. Submit Attachments 1 and 2 by electronic mail to jacqueline.y.sivongxay.civ@us.navy.mil and jessica.w.lung.civ@us.navy.mil no later than September 23, 2026 at 2:00 PM HST. After review of the responses to this notice, a pre-solicitation announcement may be published on the SAM.gov website should the Government intend to proceed with this procurement. This Sources Sought notice is for planning purposes only and shall not be construed as a Request for Proposal or as an obligation on the part of the Government. Since this is a Sources Sought announcement only, evaluation letters will be not be issued to any respondent. The Government will not provide a debriefing on the results of this notice. title: SOURCES SOUGHT LEXYCOM RADIO MOXA NPORT
description: The Government is conducting market research with the intent to procure, under only one responsible source, where no other suppliers or service will satisfy the agency requirements. The Naval Facilities Engineering Systems Command, Hawaii (NAVFAC Hawaii) is conducting market research to determine if other potential products/services can provide a telemetry radio that has equal performance requirements as the Lexycom Terra Radios, manufactured by Lexycom Technologies, Inc., 2043 East 11th St., Loveland, CO, USA, 80537. Additionally, NAVFAC Hawaii is also conducting market research to determine if other potential products/services can provide a media converter that has equal performance requirements as the MOXA Nport 5110 Media Converter, manufactured by Moxa Inc., 601 Valencia Ave, Suite 100 Brea, CA, USA, 92823. The alternate radio product/service must meet the following requirements/specifications: Radio communication must be capable of outputting within the 156-174 MHz frequency band. Must achieve an average RF channel data rate of ~10 kbps, optimized for MODBUS protocols. Must utilize a 50W power supply. Mesh, routing is based on IP[MH1] addresses. All RF transfers can be cyphered in real-time by an on-board NIST-certified cryptographic module. Radio must support and integrate network protocols for Peer to Peer (P2P), Peer to Master (P2M), anybody-to-anybody with pre-determined packet routing. Compatible with ModBUS, HSQ, and data serial interface. The alternate media converter product/service must meet the following requirements/specifications: Media converter must support transmission of serial communications over a TCP/IP Ethernet network for integration with the existing Modbus radio communication system. Media converter must provide a 10/100BaseT(X) copper Ethernet RJ45 interface and an RS-232 DB9 serial interface. Media converter must support TCP Server and TCP Client operating modes. Media converter must support configurable RS-232 serial communication parameters for compatibility with the existing communication system Media converter must operate from 12�48 VDC power for compatibility with the control panel power system. This notification is for market research purposes only and should not be construed as a commitment of any kind by the U.S. Government to issue a solicitation, request for proposals, quotes, or invitation of bids or award a contract. Interested parties with a comparable product meeting the requirements described in this announcement are invited to submit complete technical data, information and specifications in order for the Government to conduct an evaluation of your product to ensure compatibility with the existing system. Technical response shall be typed, at least 11 point Times New Roman or larger, single-sided 8.5 by 11 inch pages and submitted in Adobe PDF format. Also, provide company information and point of contract (name, title, email, phone, mailing address). The Government will not reimburse any responder for any costs associated with information submitted in response to this sources sought announcement. Any information provided to the Government in response to this request for information (RFI) will become U.S. Government property and will not be returned. All proprietary or classified information will be treated appropriately. The Government reserves the right to disregard any submittal that is incomplete or vague. Please do not submit your company brochure. Interested parties shall submit information and specifications to Ms. Ku�ulei Kamikawa, Contract Specialist at kuulei.m.kamikawa.civ@.us.navy.mil. Interested parties responding to this announcement by September 23, 2026 at 2:00 p.m. Hawaii Standard Time will be considered.
